questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), matrix-producing connective tissue cells synthesizing collagen and elastin fibers are:
questions.explanation: Fibroblasts synthesize fibers and ground substance.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), histamine, heparin, and serotonin are released during inflammation by:
questions.explanation: Mast cells release histamine, heparin, and serotonin.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), tissue macrophages residing in loose connective tissue proper are:
questions.explanation: Histocytes are phagocytic macrophages in connective tissue proper.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), antibody-producing plasma cells differentiate from activated:
questions.explanation: Plasma cells derive from antigen-stimulated B-lymphocytes.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), tendons attaching skeletal muscle to bone consist of:
options: A) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT
questions.answer: A) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT
questions.explanation: Tendons are composed of dense regular white fibrous CT.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), tough shock-absorbing cartilage in intervertebral discs lacking perichondrium is:
questions.explanation: Fibrocartilage has thick collagen bundles and forms intervertebral discs.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3), the structural unit of compact bone comprising Haversian canal and lamellae is:
questions.explanation: The osteon is the functional structural unit of compact bone.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3 - MSQ), select all cell types residing in Loose Areolar Connective Tissue matrix: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Areolar CT matrix contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, and plasma cells.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 3 - MSQ), select all Granulocytic Leucocytes in circulating blood: (Select all that apply)
In Practice Exam (Topic 3 - MSQ), select all formed blood elements: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Formed blood elements comprise RBCs, WBCs, and Platelets.
